mapper.sql: p.id, p.user_id, p.body, p.image_path, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.username, u.display_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS like_count
SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes liked WHERE liked.post_id = p.id AND liked.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS liked_by_me FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id

sql.if: AND (p.user_id = #{viewerId} OR p.user_id IN (SELECT followee_id FROM follows WHERE follower_id = #{viewerId}))

mapper.select: SELECT , 0 AS liked_by_me FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, body, image_path, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{body}, #{imagePath}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS VARCHAR)), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS VARCHAR)) )
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET body = #{body}, image_path = #{imagePath}, updated_at = CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS VARCHAR) WHERE id = #{id}
